crosswalks.historical_boundary: Hinenosho manor, including Hineno and Iriyamada villages; present-day Izumisano area
crosswalks.notes: The current geometry inventory has no Hinenosho/Izumi manor polygon. The generic `izumi` location is in Settsu and cannot be substituted.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Dilya and Tanabṭawayh canal village clusters in the Fayyum depression
crosswalks.notes: The published maps identify canal and village relationships but do not provide a GIS polygon that can be overlaid on the EU5 location geometry.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Fayyum depression hydraulic system and associated villages
crosswalks.notes: Physical-system evidence does not define an exact settlement boundary; no broad Egypt selector is allowed.
